title: Code and analysis records for: Hidden oestrogen-receptor activity in immunohistochemically ER-negative breast cancer (SCAN-B reproducibility and composition study)
description: Analysis code, SHA-256-hashed internal analysis plan (25 October 2026), amendments A1–A3, deviations log, results files and figures for a secondary analysis of public data (GEO GSE96058, GSE40049, GSE38167, GSE337499, GSE337500) on the reproducibility, definition dependence and composition of transcriptomic hidden ER activity calls in IHC ER-negative breast cancer.
